admin_checks_after_order: The warehouse admin can check the shipping cost only after the customer has created a delivery order in the system
company_truck_schedule: Company truck rounds follow the earlier queue. The earliest delivery is the day after payment
dispatch_queue: Dispatch follows the payment-notification queue. Orders that miss the cut-off are sent the next day
domestic_free_storage_note: (Parcels are stored free at the Thai warehouse for 5 days, counting from the day the parcel arrives in Thailand. After 5 days a storage fee of 10 baht per piece per day applies.)
intl_ask_before_order: To avoid any misunderstanding in shipping, please ask about the product type before every order
intl_study_criteria: Please read the basic criteria for classifying product types
jt_box_limit: Only for goods that can be packed in a box no larger than size L (or a 30x40x50 cm box)
jt_size_limit: Only for parcels whose three sides add up to no more than 150 cm and that weigh no more than 20 kg
post_box_limit: Only for parcels that can be packed in a box no larger than size L (or a 30x40x50 cm box)
post_ems_limit: Weight limit of 20 kg for EMS
post_registered_limit: Weight limit of 10 kg for registered post
post_suitable: Suitable for parcels up to 10 kg, or as agreed with the customer before dispatch
provincial_company_helps: The company will check and find a suitable carrier for the customer
provincial_dispatch_queue: Dispatch follows the payment-notification queue. Orders that cannot be sent on the day they are placed go out in the next day's round
provincial_pay_on_delivery: Delivery within Thailand is paid by the customer to the courier, starting at 100 baht per piece
provincial_service_fee: A service fee applies, covering repair and repacking, with no limit on the number of parcels
self_pickup_hours: Pickup is available 9:00-18:00, Monday to Saturday. The warehouse is in the Don Mueang area, near Wat Thung Si Kan
truck_free_over_5000: For shipping fees of 5,000 baht or more, delivery is free by 2.1 m box pickup truck only, within Bangkok, Nonthaburi, Samut Prakan and Pathum Thani
truck_large_parcels_1: If the customer has many parcels, or parcels too large and heavy to be lifted by hand, the company will deliver by chartered four-wheel or six-wheel truck, or crane truck
truck_large_parcels_2: with an additional service fee starting at 2,000 baht. Delivery is available throughout Thailand
truck_under_5000: For shipping fees under 5,000 baht, delivery costs 400 baht per trip, within Bangkok, Nonthaburi, Samut Prakan and Pathum Thani
warehouse_title: China warehouse address (for the China shipping-only service)
